text: たたかってる　ばあいじゃ　なかった　でぐちは　どっち　だっけ？

structure.jp: たたかってる　ばあいじゃ　なかった
structure.en: this was no time to be battling

structure.jp: でぐちは　どっち　だっけ？
structure.en: which way was the exit again?

patterns.name: 〜ばあいではない
patterns.span: たたかってる　ばあいじゃ　なかった
patterns.explanation: A verb plus ばあいではない says 'this is no time to be doing that'; じゃ is the casual form of では. たたかってる　ばあいじゃ　なかった = 'it was no time to be battling'.

patterns.name: 〜っけ
patterns.explanation: っけ at the end shows you are trying to remember something you once knew. どっち　だっけ = 'which way was it again?'

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: てる is the shortened spoken form of ている, which shows an action going on. たたかってる = 'be battling'.
